candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Mobile Application Engineer, Enterprise Knowledge Base

## Experience

- Developed the delta-sync module for the knowledge base app (Kotlin and Swift), replacing the full-catalogue download with change-set downloads and a resumable transfer when field devices lose connectivity.
- Reduced the sync failure rate from 6.8 percent to 2.1 percent of sync attempts between the March and June releases, measured by the app analytics dashboard against the product's published baseline of 6.8 percent for the January to February period.
- Coordinated release contents with the content team for four releases; my part covered the sync and search changes, while the release manager decided the release date and scope.
- Triaged crash and sync reports from field staff through the support queue, documenting root causes in the engineering wiki and linking each to the fixing change.
- Responsibilities included offline sync development, quality-indicator reporting, release coordination and support triage for the knowledge base app over about two years.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the sync-failure-rate report exported from the app analytics dashboard (weekly rate, attempts, baseline line, release markers for March and June) and the delta-sync design note, with the dashboard export identifiers as a verification trail.
